subject: Discovery recap + quick check on approval path and EoQ timing
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@clearwavehealth.com>, Devon Park <devon.park@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + next steps (Clearwave)

Hi Aditi / Devon — great to meet today. Quick recap from our 30-min discovery and suggested next steps so we stay aligned before EoQ.

High-level takeaways:
- Goal: reduce clinical documentation latency for revenue ops by ~30% and surface coding suggestions at point-of-care.
- Primary constraint: data residency + audit logs (SOC2 + hospital IT firewall).
- Expected pilot scope: 2 outpatient clinics, ~25 users, 90-day evaluation.
- Decision-makers: Aditi (IT), Devon (Head of Product), CFO (final approval; budget-owner).

Suggested next steps:
1) Share pilot SOW draft and pricing range (attached SOW-draft-v1.pdf & pricing-grid.xlsx). Action: Ben to send SOW (today).
2) Security artifacts: we will provide SOC2 summary + data flow diagram. Action: Marissa to add SOC2 excerpt and log-retention notes.
3) Approval path: who needs a buy-in slide / finance package for the CFO? Action: Can Aditi confirm approvers and typical procurement timeline?

Bump items / open questions:
- Is budget allocated this quarter or need approval in Q3?
- Are there any integration blockers (FHIR endpoints, VPN) we should surface to infra?

Attaching discovery notes and the SOW draft for your review. If it helps, we can do a 15-min sync with the CFO next week to walk the commercial outline.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0187
Redwood Inference

Attachments: clearwave-discovery-notes.pdf (PDF), SOW-draft-v1.pdf (PDF), pricing-grid.xlsx (XLSX)

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps (Clearwave)

Aditi — circling back on the SOW & approvals. Did you get a chance to look at the draft and pricing options I attached on Sunday?

If it's easier: happy to convert the SOW into a 1-slide commercial summary for the CFO and share that directly.

Quick one-line confirmation would be great so we know whether to hold room in our Q3 pilot capacity.

Thanks — Ben

Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps (Clearwave)

Hi Ben — apologies for the delay. Thanks for the write-up and the SOW. High level: we like the pilot outline. A few internal notes:

- Security: our InfoSec requires the SOC2 summary + network diagram before any signed SOW. Please have Marissa send those artifacts.
- Budget: CFO has limited discretionary spend remaining for July; looks like formal approval may need to go through procurement in early August unless we get a small pilot exception.
- Approvers: CTO and CFO will need the commercial summary; procurement reviews legal redlines.

I can coordinate a 15-min CFO sync next Tue (Aug 5) if Redwood can provide the lightweight one-slide and the InfoSec packet by end of next week (July 31).

Would you also confirm whether pilot data will remain in-region and if we can sign a short amendment for retention limits?

Thanks — Aditi

aditi.shah@clearwavehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-2201

Subject: Fwd: Discovery recap + next steps (Clearwave) — EoQ priority check / escalate?

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding thread with Aditi. She confirmed the need for SOC2 + a quick one-slide commercial summary, but indicated budget may push approval to early August unless we qualify for a small pilot exception.

Ask:
- Marissa: can you package the SOC2 excerpt + network/retention note and share by EOD July 31? Also flag any legal redline risks in the SOW-draft-v1.pdf.
- Rishi: if procurement pushes to August, would we be comfortable offering a temporary 30-day pilot discount to lock in an EoQ exception? If yes, what's the maximum concession?

I want to avoid slipping this into the August queue if possible — this is a strategic outpatient account with clear upsell motion. If we need to escalate for a one-time EoQ exception, I can loop in Sales Ops / CRO.

Thanks — Ben
